title: Attribute repeated failures to linkage or tools
narrative: When the same failure class repeats, Fangore needs structured attribution so the process can improve — not one-off output patches. Accepts inspiration requirement 11[^insp-r11].
implementation: `attribute_error` / `detect_repeated_failure_classes` in `mechaharness.failure_attribution` map errors to categories for traces and offline mining.
validation: Kind `failure_attribution_trace`. Soft expects linkage category and repeated class detection.
